note: Draft for round 14 integration. Not loaded by the planner until copied into method_requirements.json (new SHA), the method graph release and constraint_probes.json as listed in docs/ROUND14_GROUP_ANALYSIS.md.

design.effect_term: first term; continuous variable or two-level factor (exactly one design column)
design.covariates: optional additional terms, e.g. sex, age, intracranial volume
design.per_region_model: OLS with intercept, one model per (hemisphere, metric, label_key)
design.multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg across all fitted regions of both hemispheres
design.effect_size: Cohen's d (two-group, no covariates) or Pearson r (single continuous effect); otherwise none

output_contract.rows: one per fitted region; skipped regions listed in the JSON summary

parameters.object: subjects per level of the effect factor

parameters.text: Report the FDR family, excluded subjects and site/scanner composition; regional means from atlas parcellations are descriptive of the atlas, not of individual anatomy.
